reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need a sachet to carry around. I'd also forget it on the counter half the time and a bigger bottle is cheaper per day.
objection: I don't need it to go. I'm paying extra for the sachet packaging when my bottle at home does the same job for less.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $0.50 a day or a real coupon deal, plus a reason I'd actually need it on the go.
